title: Bear cub reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Ground / seat shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='32' ry='7' fill='#3b2a1a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Bear body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#b5793a'/>
  
  <!-- Bear belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#d4a05c'/>
  
  <!-- Bear legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#9a6229'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#9a6229'/>
  
  <!-- Paw pads -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  
  <!-- Left arm holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='66' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#b5793a' transform='rotate(20 31 66)'/>
  
  <!-- Right arm holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='66' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#b5793a' transform='rotate(-20 69 66)'/>
  
  <!-- Book - left page -->
  <path d='M30 58 L50 62 L50 78 L30 74 Z' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <!-- Book - right page -->
  <path d='M70 58 L50 62 L50 78 L70 74 Z' fill='#e8e0cc'/>
  
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#c46a5a' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <path d='M30 58 L50 62 L70 58' fill='none' stroke='#c46a5a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M30 74 L50 78 L70 74' fill='none' stroke='#c46a5a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  
  <!-- Book pages lines -->
  <line x1='35' y1='64' x2='46' y2='66.5' stroke='#b8a88a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='68' x2='46' y2='70.5' stroke='#b8a88a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='66.5' x2='65' y2='64' stroke='#b8a88a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='70.5' x2='65' y2='68' stroke='#b8a88a' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Bear head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#b5793a'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='8' fill='#b5793a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='4.5' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='8' fill='#b5793a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='4.5' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#5a3a1a'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 50 54 46' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a1a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43.2' cy='33.8' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.2' cy='33.8' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='3' fill='#e8a080' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='3' fill='#e8a080' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Tiny tail -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='4' fill='#9a6229'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='2' fill='#e8c48a'/>
</svg>
